name: OnTheClock
description_en:
OnTheClock combines employee timecards, scheduling and time-off management, with payroll as an additional product. Employees can clock in through desktop/mobile/web or kiosk routes, while administrators review hours before payroll.

Location controls and overtime calculations help implement a policy; they do not independently establish that a configured rule is correct or that wages were paid.
description_zh:
OnTheClock 结合员工工时卡、排班及休假管理，薪资作为额外产品。员工可经桌面/手机/网页或 kiosk 打卡，管理员在发薪前审查工时。

定位控制及加班计算用于实施政策，不独立证明配置规则正确或工资已支付。

core_features.explanation_en: Record punches and review hours for a pay period.
core_features.explanation_zh: 记录打卡并审核工资周期工时。

core_features.explanation_en: Payroll adds tax forms/direct deposit services under separate fees and eligibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: 薪资另加税表/直接存款服务，并有独立费用及资格。

en: Configure employees, work schedules, PTO, location controls and pay periods, then inspect a shift with a missed punch or break correction. Compare approved timecards to the payroll import. GPS permission failure is a device/control condition, not proof of employee misconduct. No punch or payroll was performed here.
zh: 配置员工、班次、休假、地点控制及工资周期，再检查漏打卡或休息更正的班次，对照已批工时卡与薪资导入。GPS 权限失败属于设备/控制条件，不证明员工违规。本文未打卡或发薪。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Time base plus per-employee charge; payroll adds its own base/employee charge and one-time onboarding.

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: approve a shift before payroll
sections.en: Configure employees, work schedules, PTO, location controls and pay periods, then inspect a shift with a missed punch or break correction. Compare approved timecards to the payroll import. GPS permission failure is a device/control condition, not proof of employee misconduct. No punch or payroll was performed here.
sections.zh: 配置员工、班次、休假、地点控制及工资周期，再检查漏打卡或休息更正的班次，对照已批工时卡与薪资导入。GPS 权限失败属于设备/控制条件，不证明员工违规。本文未打卡或发薪。

sections.title_en: Payroll is additional to time tracking
sections.title_zh: 薪资另加在时间记录之上
sections.en:
Time tracking/scheduling/PTO is $4 per employee monthly plus a $5 monthly base. Payroll is an additional $6 per employee plus $40 base monthly, and a required one-time $250 migration/onboarding fee. For ten employees the listed time plan is $45 and added payroll $100 before onboarding/tax; the combined component total is $145, not $65 from a particular calculator default. These are arithmetic examples, not quotes.

The trial is thirty days without a card. More than one hundred employees require enterprise consultation. Final currency/tax and payroll jurisdiction/eligibility must be confirmed; US W-2/1099 references do not establish worldwide payroll.
sections.zh:
时间/排班/休假每员工每月 $4，加 $5 月基础费。薪资额外每员工 $6，加 $40 月基础费，并要求一次性 $250 迁移/入门费。十员工的时间方案按组件为 $45，薪资另加 $100，合计 $145，未含入门/税费，不能直接套用某个默认计算器的 $65。算例不是报价。

试用三十天无需卡，超过一百员工需企业咨询。最终货币/税费和薪资地区资格需确认；美国 W-2/1099 不证明全球发薪。

sections.title_en: Keep corrections and export ownership explicit
sections.en:
Attendance administrators should establish who edits and approves time, how disputes are resolved and which payroll system receives it. After an uncertain import, reconcile the original batch before sending again. Time-off balances also need an opening reconciliation.

No payroll, tax filing, geofence, offline, software licence, export completeness or restoration test was performed. This managed service is not a verified self-hosted distribution. A consultant needing only project billing may not require the attendance/payroll scope.
sections.zh:
考勤管理员应明确谁编辑/审批时间、如何处理争议、由哪个薪资系统接收。导入不确定时应核对原批次再重发，休假余额也需期初核对。

未测试发薪、报税、地理围栏、离线、软件许可、导出完整性或恢复。托管服务不是已核实自托管发行版，只需项目计费的顾问未必需要考勤/薪资范围。
